title: Issues when doing profile switch on DANA R
body:
I perform profile switch and it often leads to problems:

* Today I received more than five notifications that profile was updated. During that time connection status bar shows lot of communication with pump. I'm adding logs. You can check from 10:31:52.

* I have also older logs with same action but it was unable to properly connect and update basal in the pump.  Log from 14:00:10.

[Profile_switching_problems.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/6329463/Profile_switching_problems.zip)

My configuration: AAPS 2.8.2, Nightscout: 14.2.1, Samsung Galaxy S10 Lite, DANA R Model: 03, Protocol: 03, Code: B3. I didn't noticed other communication problems between pump and phone.

```
[20210423_ProfileSwitches.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/6366928/20210423_ProfileSwitches.zip)

I have applied my change:

```
    @Volatile
    private var thread: QueueThread? = null
```

20:09 APK with updated CommandQueue installed
20:10 Profile switch -> 2x profile updated notification
20:13 Profile switch -> 2x profile updated notification
20:13 SMB
20:15 Profile switch -> 2x profile updated notification
20:16 Profile switch -> nothing happened until 20:18 -> SMB -> 2x profile updated notification
20:20 Profile switch -> 2x profile updated notification

Each time profile was updated successfully immediately (with 2x notification) or after some delay before pump communication. There were also some SMBs or other loop commands in between so there were more items in the queue sometimes (as expected). So for me it looks like it works. 

[20210423_ProfileSwitches_patched_with_volatile.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/6367579/20210423_ProfileSwitches_patched_with_volatile.zip)

I have an update here. That `@Volalile` update is not fix of my problem. After few days of use it goes wrong again.

`CommandQueue` is designed as `@Singleton`. That's ok and reasonable. But there is also `independentConnect` method called exclusively from `DanaRExecutionService` (I'm on Dana R). This method creates new instances of `CommandQueue` for some purposes. After some invocations there are 2 or more instances of `CommandQueue`. Are those new instances only temporal? I don't know. There is `CommandQueue::init` method where is registration of each `CommandQueue` instance to `.toObservable(EventProfileNeedsUpdate::class.java)` (therefore long living instances?). This is also the case for those instances created by `independentConnect`. 

Here I think it is not intended to handle profile switches multiple times by multiple concurrent `CommandQueue`s.

I did some modification of logged messages with printing hashCode of instances:

```
// Application restarted by me followed by first CommandQueue instance with hashCode 150406160
13:04:58.265 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-85] D/PUMPBTCOMM: [SerialIOThread.disconnect():200]: Disconnected: Application exit
13:04:59.615 [main] D/PUMPQUEUE: [CommandQueue.<init>():109]: New CommandQueue instance created: 150406160, thread: Thread[main,5,main]

// Here is independentConnect which creates another CommandQueue instance with hashCode 267532805
15:16:25.856 [Thread-1100] D/PUMPQUEUE: [CommandQueue.independentConnect():215]: Starting new queue on Thread[Thread-1100,5,main]
15:16:25.857 [Thread-1100] D/PUMPQUEUE: [CommandQueue.<init>():109]: New CommandQueue instance created: 267532805, thread: Thread[Thread-1100,5,main]
15:16:25.858 [Thread-1100] D/PUMPQUEUE: [CommandQueue.independentConnect():217]: New queue on Thread[Thread-1100,5,main] started: 267532805
15:16:25.859 [Thread-1100] D/PUMPQUEUE: [CommandQueue.add():164]: Adding: CommandReadStatus - READSTATUS bolusingInterrupted 

// Some profile switch later

it can be the issue. try call 
`tempCommandQueue.disposable.clear()` at the end of `independentConnect`
`independentConnect` is used when connection is broken during communication with R pump. singleton instance can hold BT connection in undefined state and simply call `readStatus()` don't work
Ok, from my point of view, this last fix solved the issues. Profile switching works as expected in few seconds without issues. Thanks
